issues.claim: And what that you build today will be the most expensive to rewrite in five years?
issues.problem: Ungrammatical English ('what that you build'). The RU hint reads naturally.
issues.suggestedFix: And what that you build today will be the most expensive to rewrite in five years? -> And which of the things you build today will be the most expensive to rewrite in five years?

issues.claim: Одинаковы ли требования к публичным страницам, к интерактивному клиентскому приложению и к внутренней админке?
issues.problem: The hint lists the exact surfaces from answer point 1 ('decide per surface'), so it comes close to giving away the central idea, in both locales.
issues.suggestedFix: Make it more general, e.g. 'Are the requirements the same for every part of the product? And what that you build today will be the most expensive to rewrite in five years?' (same in RU).

issues.claim: AOT speeds up execution but increases the download size
issues.problem: This is correct (AOT-compiled Blazor WebAssembly apps are larger and run faster). However, the AOT claim and the mitigation list (trimming, compression, caching, prerendering, InteractiveAuto) do not appear in the fetched excerpts of the cited pages. The generator notes say the same.
issues.suggestedFix: Optionally add a link to the Blazor WebAssembly hosting/deployment docs (host-and-deploy/webassembly) or the AOT/trimming docs and add its title to linkTitles in both locales. The facts themselves do not need to change.

issues.claim: Встраивание компонентов Blazor в JavaScript-приложение через custom elements ... или сгенерированные компоненты Angular и React документация Microsoft называет экспериментальным и неподдерживаемым
issues.problem: This is accurate according to the js-spa-frameworks excerpt. But the same page describes rendering Razor components from JavaScript (root components), which is not labelled experimental in the excerpt. A reader may conclude that there is no supported embedding path at all.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a short clause in both locales: only custom elements and generated Angular/React components are marked experimental; dynamic root-component rendering from JS is a separate mechanism whose current support status must be checked before relying on it.
